title: Turn digit images into sequences
description: You represent each image as eight column observations.

steps.description: You load digit images as floating-point arrays and labels as integers. Dividing the image values by 16 normalizes them to the stated range [0,1].
You transpose each 8 by 8 image. Each original column becomes one row in the returned sequence.

steps.question: Does transposing the image change the sequence's shape?
steps.answer: The shape stays (8,8). Its meaning changes: the first axis selects an image column, and each observation contains eight values.

steps.description: You create one sequence per image and request the total count and first sequence shape. The supplied recording contains no printed values.
